title: Agent-memory benchmarking harness: retrieval quality, latency/cost, and isolation-under-load
summary: Repeatable benchmark producing numbers directly comparable to the figures cited in ai-agent-platform-competitive-analysis.md (Oracle 93.8% LongMemEval, Mem0 91.6 LOCOMO, Zep 94.8% DMR), plus a custom multi-tenant isolation-under-load measurement this SDK's governed-substrate positioning depends on.
description:
Build a `benchmarks/` harness (not shipped in the wheel — same treatment as `project-management/`, exclude via the hatchling wheel target) with three parts:

1. **Retrieval quality** — a LongMemEval-shaped synthetic dataset (multi-session conversations with planted facts, later contradictions, and questions requiring extraction/multi-session reasoning/temporal reasoning/knowledge updates/abstention, per the five LongMemEval ability categories) run through `MemoryStore.remember()`/`search()`, scored by an LLM-judge for correctness against the LongMemEval methodology (arXiv 2410.10813) closely enough that the resulting number is honestly comparable to the vendor figures already cited in ai-agent-platform-competitive-analysis.md — document any methodology deviation explicitly rather than reporting a number as "LongMemEval" if it isn't.
2. **Latency/cost** — per-`remember()`/per-`search()` call latency and, since this SDK's write path is developer-controlled rather than passive-LLM-extraction, per-turn token cost only where a `Consolidator`/`Reconciler`/`Summarizer` hook is actually configured (the no-op default path should report near-zero LLM cost, which is itself a comparison point against the extraction-pipeline competitors in the market study).
3. **Isolation-under-load** — concurrent writers across many synthetic tenants/agents hammering `search()`/`list_all()`, asserting zero cross-scope result leakage under load, not just under the single-threaded conditions VER-5's manual audit checked. This is the differentiator the SWOT in ai-agent-platform-competitive-analysis.md claims (governed substrate); it should be measured, not just asserted.

Requires a live Db2 instance and an `EmbeddingProvider`/LLM configured — this only runs on demand (a `make benchmark` / `scripts/run_benchmarks.py` entry point), not in the PH-1/PH-2 CI jobs. Publish results as a markdown report checked into `project-management/` (e.g. `BENCHMARKS.md`) with the exact dataset size, model, and embedding provider used, so numbers are reproducible and honestly caveated the same way ai-agent-platform-competitive-analysis.md caveats the vendor-reported figures it cites.

comments.text: Done. Built full benchmarks/ harness (excluded from wheel — same treatment as project-management/). Three suites: (1) Retrieval quality — synthetic LongMemEval-shaped dataset (5 categories: extraction, multi_session, temporal_reasoning, knowledge_update, abstention; n_per_category configurable; seeded for reproducibility) run through remember()/search() and scored by a pluggable judge. Two judge tiers: KeywordMatchJudge (dependency-free fallback, explicitly labeled NOT an LLM judge in every report) and GeminiJudge (real LLM judge, free-tier, same CORRECT/INCORRECT verdict shape as LongMemEval's GPT-4o judge — produces numbers honestly comparable in kind to vendor-reported LongMemEval figures when paired with a real embedding model). Three embedding providers: HashingEmbeddingProvider (no deps, default), SentenceTransformersEmbeddingProvider (local free), GeminiEmbeddingProvider (hosted free-tier). Every report stamps the exact judge/embedding/dataset-size config and flags any methodology deviation in bold. Three documented deviations recorded in BENCHMARKS.md: synthetic dataset not the real LongMemEval 500 questions; configurable/small default sample size; no graph retrieval (Db2 VECTOR cosine only). (2) Latency/cost — per-call wall-clock percentiles (mean/p50/p95/p99/max) for remember() and search(); LLM cost reported only when a Consolidator/Reconciler/Summarizer hook is configured (default no-op path reports $0.00 / 0 hook calls — the comparison point vs. passive-extraction competitors). CostTrackingHook wraps any hook with call-count + ~4 chars/token estimate, documented as an approximation. (3) Isolation under load — ThreadPoolExecutor across tenants×agents_per_tenant synthetic scopes all writing+reading concurrently; each returned row checked for scope-field match AND absence of other scopes' [[MARKER]] tokens; zero leakage asserted (EXIT CODE 2 on failure); extends VER-5's static SQL audit to real concurrent ConnectionPool load. Entry point: scripts/run_benchmarks.py (exits 0/1/2); Makefile benchmark target. project-management/BENCHMARKS.md checked in as methodology-documenting placeholder (populated by make benchmark against live Db2). pyproject.toml [benchmark] extras group for sentence-transformers/google-generativeai. All ruff checks pass; 542 unit tests pass at 87% coverage (no regression). DECISIONS.md entry appended with full methodology, deviation list, and results caveat.
